description: Solomos Square opens onto Zakynthos harbor, with the standing statue, the neoclassical town hall, and the low church of Agios Nikolaos of the Mole. Boats lie along the quay and a hill rises behind the roofs. The sky is clear, about 16.2°C. The sun has just risen. The tall campanile of Agios Dionysios, farther along the waterfront, is outside this frame.
